issues.legal_issue: Whether an increase in the actual quantity of work beyond the estimated Bill of Quantities, without an instructed change to the work’s form, quality, or design, constitutes a variation under the contract permitting the Engineer to revise the agreed rate.
Whether the contractual thresholds for considering a change in an item’s rate require the rate to be changed or merely enable the parties to consider such a change.

Whether a court exercising jurisdiction under Section 37 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act may set aside an arbitral award after it has been upheld under Section 34 when the tribunal’s contractual interpretation is a plausible view.
